These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

1. 当前判断

截至2026-07-30，通信设备应按“AI/IDC上电交付收费站”而非泛AI硬件beta刷新：融资盘净买入只说明交易动量仍在，不能抵消板块净流出130.51亿与高估值/一年涨幅风险 [mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]] [mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]] evidence ref。新增链条证据显示，2027-2028年capex兑现的主约束已从芯片/融资迁移到firm power、变压器、配套发电和可利用率，订单需验证上电转化率而非只看算力需求 evidence ref evidence ref。该结论不支持把通信设备并入th_p_ad60e0f7的执行主题，因激活广度和利润质量阈值仍未被新证据推翻。

Determine whether the oil shock is persistent or self-reversing

Owner: chief-economist · Thesis v8 · Ticks: 4 · Materials: 82 · Deadline: 11d left · project_id: rp_401a6699b7364beb

Kickoff: Track the half-life of the Strait of Hormuz and energy-price shock that drove the May/June inflation concern. This matters because a persistent oil shock validates tighter central-bank pricing, while a fast reversal raises the risk that the Fed overtightens into a fading supply shock.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when oil prices and the next two CPI/PCE energy-pass-through prints show either sustained inflation pressure from energy or a clear oil-dump easing path that removes energy as the dominant upside inflation driver.

1. 当前判断

基准仍是“自反转”而非持久油震：6-26 WTI $69.23击穿73-75底座、Brent较4月回落约22.7%，霍尔木兹溢价的半衰期短于政策窗口，继续支持 th_T18 的“地缘溢价出清”框架 [thesis:th_T18]。但7-30材料把尾部风险重新抬高：霍尔木兹溢价可在约75%分布中重推总体能源CPI、支持9月加息尾部，却仍是总体项且路径依赖，并未确认核心二阶传导 evidence ref evidence ref。这 CONTRADICTS th_p_2ca41751：其“Brent站稳05”假设与6-26 WTI $69.23、Brent回撤约22.7%不一致；也削弱 th_p_e671e6bd 的“冲突重启必打断降温”强版本，除非后两轮CPI/PCE能源项转热 [thesis:th_p_2ca41751] [thesis:th_p_e671e6bd]。

2. 关键证据

  • 6-26 WTI $69.23跌破73-75底座，油价地板论被击穿 [thesis:th_T18]
  • Brent较4月回落约22.7%

Fed CPI/FOMC regime switch

Owner: global-macro · Thesis v12 · Ticks: 6 · Materials: 427 · Deadline: 7d left · project_id: rp_21a5d2d17f6f497f

Kickoff: Track whether the CPI and June FOMC/SEP event gate turns current labor and inflation pressure into a confirmed higher-rate regime. This matters because the analyst is using 10Y UST levels around 4.75%-4.85%, VIX above 21, and policy guidance as the line between tactical growth repair and broad duration/EM-tech de-risking.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when official CPI plus the June FOMC statement/dots either confirm a hawkish regime shift with 10Y UST yields sustaining above the 4.75%-4.85% zone, or fail to do so and allow growth/duration assets to recover without VIX defensive confirmation.

Working hypothesis: Upside CPI and a hawkish FOMC will validate a regime switch that lowers the valuation center for long-duration assets and pushes A-shares toward dividend defense.

截至2026-07-30，闸门仍未resolved：7月29日FOMC是鹰派按兵不动，暂停降低即时加息冲击但未降低紧缩尾部；真正验证点转为BEA核心PCE、油价与10Y是否把4.75%-4.85%变成支撑evidence refevidence ref。 这支持 th_T04 的“2026年不降息”基准，但把强再通胀确认门槛收紧为终端销售≥2.5-3%＋核心PCE≥0.3%＋信用走阔；单期能源抬头或热GDP表头不足以确认 regime switchevidence ref
